chunks: 4615 - Al-Sadiq عليه السلام said: “Indeed, I dislike for a man to die while there still remains upon him a trait from the traits of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله that he has not practiced.”
So I said to him: “Then did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله practice mut'ah?” He said: “Yes.”
And he recited this verse: “And when the Prophet confided to one of his wives a statement” up to His, Exalted is He, saying: “previously married and virgins.”

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام, the speaker of the hadith
key_terms.الْآيَةَ: the Qur'anic verse recited as evidence
key_terms.تَمَتَّعَ: performed mut'ah, i.e. temporary marriage in this context
key_terms.خِلَالِ: traits or practices, here referring to the prophetic ways
key_terms.رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله

ai.seo_question: Did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله practice mut'ah according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: The hadith encourages acting upon the sunnah (prophetic tradition) of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله and disapproves of leaving a prophetic practice unfulfilled. In this context, Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام affirms that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله practiced mut'ah and cites Qur'an 66:3-5 in support.
